caption: The drawing features a single goblet centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The goblet is depicted in shades of translucent blue-green, with the glass's curves and thicknesses suggested by areas of lighter and darker coloring along its form. The bowl of the goblet is wide and slightly flared at the top, tapering down into a narrow neck that connects to a stem composed of two rounded, bulbous sections. The base of the goblet is circular with radiating segments, also rendered in blue-green tones that mimic the qualities of glass. A thin rectangular border encases the composition, and the bottom right corner bears the signature "G. Capelli" in small, neat handwriting.
title: Goblet
